3: By day 13, MRI abnormalities had begun to improve, and her level of consciousness improved to E4VTM6.
4: She was diagnosed with severe heat stroke (APACHE II score 42, SOFA score 15), intubated, and treated with extracorporeal cooling, fluid resuscitation, and DIC therapy; fursultiamine and levothyroxine were also given.
On day 6, brain MRI showed bilateral cerebellar hemisphere high-signal intensity on diffusion-weighted and FLAIR images with corresponding low ADC signals.
